thread:
kevin: Quick sync idea 111  We should build an 'Investigation Lens' for automatic fallback events in Console. Central view that surfaces the decision, quick telemetry, and a sanitized sample.

lina: Love that name. What are the MVP pieces?

maria: MVP: timeline with event markers, event detail drawer (reason, policy, model version, route), one-click snapshot export, and redaction rules.

ethan: Addability: replay button to play fallback events in chronological order, and a toggled infra ribbon (GPU, node health).

kevin: Security: snapshots must be role-gated. Only 'oncall' and 'engineer' roles can view raw inputs. Everyone else sees redacted preview or first N tokens.

lina: Redaction rule proposal: strip email/SSN patterns, mask user text beyond 3 tokens unless operator has explicit export permission. Also log who viewed a raw snapshot.

opsbot: policy-eval: event created policy=auto-fallback-v1 reason="qps>reserved && latency_p99>900ms" route="/embeddings" model_version="rv-2026-04-01-1" trace=tr-9c4a sample=smpl-773

maria: For the timeline layout, prefer small-multiples per route with synced X axis. That makes cross-route cascades obvious.

kevin: UX detail: hovering a marker shows a compact tooltip: time, short trigger reason, p99, qps, link to the audit record. Click opens drawer with full details.

ethan: Telemetry contract we need: event_ts, route, policy_id, trigger_reason, metric_snapshot (p50/p95/p99), qps, model_version, trace_id, pool_type (hosted/dedicated), reserved_capacity (if dedicated), operator_override (user), override_reason. Exportable CSV + JSON.

lina: Also capture correlated infra tags: node_id, gpu_util_pct, oom_count. If infra triggered fallback, marker should be red and labeled 'infra'.

maria: Sampling windows: default 5m pre, 2m post. Operators can expand to custom ranges (30s/15m/1h). When operator clicks 'create investigation' we persist samples + traces for 24h and attach snapshot_id.

opsbot: snapshot-service: created snapshot_id=snap-1714056802 user=maria expires=86400 items=23

kevin: Acceptance criteria: lens loads <900ms for 40 events, snapshot creation <2s, replay playback supports 4x/8x speeds.

ethan: Implementation note: backend should emit compact audit event per trigger, and a secondary archive with full sample references. UI retrieves lightweight events for timeline and fetches archive only on-demand. Example event JSON in the audit log:

```
{
  "ts": 1714056789,
  "route": "/embeddings",
  "policy_id": "auto-fallback-v1",
  "reason": "qps>reserved && latency_p99>900ms",
  "metrics": {"p50":120, "p95":450, "p99":980},
  "qps": 210,
  "model_version": "rv-2026-04-01-1",
  "trace_id": "tr-9c4a",
  "pool": "dedicated",
  "reserved": 200,
  "operator": "-",
  "override": false
}
```
kevin: Keep that compact; we don't want a high-cardinality monster in the event stream. Archive links reference S3 objects with full traces.

lina: Edge case: multiple fallback events within 10s for same route. Group them visually and allow expanding group into individual events.

maria: When a fallback is due to quota on Dedicated, timeline should show a utilization overlay: reserved vs used and queued requests. Helpful for sales/RPO conversations.

ethan: Exporting: CSV for basic fields, and a ZIP for snapshot that includes sanitized samples and traces. Downloads should be auditable.

kevin: Who owns? I can take frontend microflow + mockups. Lina you can own redaction rules and access gating. Maria will wire to rollout mapping. Ethan owns telemetry schema + infra tags.

lina: On it. Will draft regex rules for PII and proposals for token truncation.

maria: I'll drop a Figma mock by EOD and link here.

opsbot: deploy-bot: mock uploaded to /mnt/protos/investigation-lens/figma-link

kevin: Great. Follow-up sync after mocks to lock schema and acceptance tests. :eyes:
